display.purpose: Section prompts, heading titles, chip labels, stacked metric numbers. 900 weight, 0.05em tracking. Not for body copy.

body.purpose: All prose, descriptions, blurbs. Humanist legibility at 1rem/1.625.

label.purpose: Counters, timestamps, ramp hints, placeholder paths. Wide tracking.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: All reveals and hover transitions. The system's default ease.

motion.name: reveal-rise
motion.purpose: Entrance of every `.reveal` element; staggered 70ms steps (70-630ms) via .reveal-delay-1..9.

motion.name: boot-in-print
motion.value: clip-path steps(var(--print-steps)) 1.2s + caret 0.6s x3 blink at 1.25s + fade 0.4s at 3.1s
motion.purpose: One-shot hero title entrance (dance of the terminal boot).

motion.name: chip-hover
motion.value: border-color + color, 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); skill tag translateY(-2px)
motion.purpose: Interaction feedback on chips/tags. Movement, never shadow.

motion.name: carousel-step
motion.purpose: 3D coverflow steps: translateX 64%/step, rotateY -34°/step, scale -6%/step, opacity 1/0.5/0.2/hidden.

components.css: .ds-skill { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--n800, #262626); background: var(--n900, #171717); border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 12px; color: var(--n300, #d4d4d4); font-size: 0.8rem; cursor: default; transition: border-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-skill > i { font-style: normal; font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1; transition: color 0.3s; } .ds-skill:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #ffffff); color: var(--heading, #ffffff); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-skill:hover > i { color: var(--accent, #ffffff); } .ds-skill-tip { position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, 6px); margin-top: 8px; width: 240px; z-index: 20; border: 1px solid var(--n700, #404040); background: var(--n900, #171717); border-radius: 3px; padding: 12px; text-align: left; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.5; font-family: var(--font-atkinson, sans-serif); color: var(--n300, #d4d4d4); opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-skill:hover .ds-skill-tip { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translate(-50%, 0); } .ds-tip-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; } .ds-tip-level { font-family: var(--font-doto, 'Doto', sans-serif); font-weight: 900; font-size: 0.65rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--heading, #ffffff); } .ds-tip-dots { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; } .ds-tip-body { display: block; margin-top: 4px; opacity: 0.8; } .ds-tip-used { display: block; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 0.65rem; color: var(--n500, #787878); } .ds-chip-label { font-family: var(--font-doto, 'Doto', sans-serif); font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }

narrative.overview: A calibrated command line that never raises its voice: `$`-precise section prompts (rendered `* title`), greyscale at rest, dot-matrix stamps over humanist body copy. Depth is never painted — 1px tonal borders and fills only, hover states move instead of lift. The light mode flips to warm Manila paper with a single Fountain Teal as accent. Motion confirms rather than performs: 16px rise-and-fade entrances on a 50ms stepped stagger are the largest resting gesture.
keyCharacteristics: greyscale-first; accent is punctuation, not paint
dot-matrix (Doto 900) headings over quiet humanist body copy (Atkinson Hyperlegible)
1px hairlines and tonal fills instead of shadows and gradients
terminal prompts (`* …`) as section headers; lowercase copy voice
reveals: fade + 16px rise, staggered 50ms; flat at rest, precision on interaction

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Accent (white or teal) is punctuation: ≤ a handful of touched pixels per viewport. If a screen needs accent to be readable, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Prompt Rule
rules.body: Every section is introduced by a terminal-style prompt — `* title` — never by a decorative banner or icon.

rules.name: The Stamp Rule
rules.body: Doto exists only in displays: headings, markers, chip labels, big metric numbers. Never body text and never long labels — dot-matrix at reading size is texture, not prose.

rules.name: The Lowercase Line
rules.body: Narrative copy is written lowercase (voice commitment), not styled `lowercase` — the runts are data, not decoration.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing is lifted by shadow, ever. Hover states move (2px rise) and recolor — they never "float".

dos: Do keep everything greyscale at rest; introduce accent only on meaning (hover, selection, current-state, prompt marks).
Do separate sections with 1px hairlines + a `* title` prompt at ~0.05em tracking.
Do stagger entrances 50ms apart (50–450ms) with translateY(16px) + fade, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
Do label machine facts in mono with wide tracking (`02 / 06`, `~/projects/slug`).
Do let the carousel express depth with transforms/opacity only.
donts: Don't use gradients, neon, or glow anywhere — flatness is the identity (confirmed anti-reference).
Don't round beyond 6px — no pills, no rounded-2xl cards (confirmed anti-reference).
Don't add box-shadows — even on hover states (The Flat-By-Default Rule).
Don't set Doto below ~0.65rem or for full sentences (The Stamp Rule).
Don't ship accent-heavy screens: if white/teal dominates a viewport, the hierarchy broke.
Don't replace the grain overlay with heavier decorative textures — 7% opacity, always.
